channel.title: AI Threat Watch: FR
channel.description: Verified case files located in FR.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Jancovici denounces alleged AI-cloned voice used in cold calls selling solar panels and insulation to French residents
item.description: Jean-Marc Jancovici says an AI imitation of his voice is being used in unsolicited commercial calls offering solar panels and insulation works. He says he has received about ten testimonies and is behind none of the calls, and he warns people not to give personal or banking details. An M6 Info clip of one call circulated on 30 October. The caller and the tool used have not been established, and no losses are reported. Target: French residents receiving the calls; Jean-Marc Jancovici (voice allegedly imitated). FR. Verification: reported.

item.title: [LOW] Tarn restaurateurs scammed with AI-generated bank proof and doctored photo
item.description: According to the Tarn gendarmerie and local press, a scam targeted restaurants around Saint-Sulpice-la-Pointe: a caller claimed a duplicate payment, then a woman showed an AI-retouched bank statement on her phone to demand a cash refund. Gendarmes recorded at least five victims or attempts, and a suspect was arrested and confessed. Target: Restaurants in the Tarn, France. FR. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] GTG-50029: lone French-speaking hacktivist breaches 14 European political entities
item.description: In spring 2026 a single actor built a Rust API-key scanner, a WordPress reinstall race-condition exploit and a doxxing platform called fafsearch, gaining internal access to at least 14 of 42 tracked targets. Target: European political parties, media, think tanks, SaaS firms. FR. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Banque de France warns of deepfakes of governor Villeroy de Galhau selling investments
item.description: The French central bank and ACPR issued a joint alert about AI deepfakes of Governor Villeroy de Galhau and ACPR chief Emmanuelle Assouan recommending investments, followed by calls demanding advance fees. Target: French savers over 50 and companies. FR. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] CERT-FR: 42 attacker groups actively use generative AI, none yet autonomous against France
item.description: ANSSI's CERT-FR published CERTFR-2026-CTI-001, a TLP:CLEAR synthesis reporting that 42 groups use GenAI such as Gemini for profiling, lures and malware, while no attack on a French entity is attributed to autonomous AI. Target: French public and private entities. FR. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] French woman loses 830,000 euros to AI-generated 'Brad Pitt' romance scam; probe opened
item.description: A French woman sent about 830,000 euros (about $855,000) over 18 months to scammers using AI-generated images of Brad Pitt, including fake hospital selfies; police in La Reunion opened a probe after her complaint. Target: Private individual (53-year-old interior designer). FR. Verification: reported.
